binary_target: label != normal, pooling exact A121, B82 and C182
fixed_settings: Existing fitted imputer and scaler; clone stored logistic estimator C, solver, tolerance and max_iter

calibration: For binary candidates, original separate normal calibration IDs, quantile 0.95 method=higher, alarm score > threshold; both references retain original stored scores and thresholds
scope: Development comparison. Preserve whole capture and continuous campaign groups. No new data or threshold/feature search.
